description: This file implements the MetricsHostReceiver class, which manages a message queue to receive metrics-related messages and processes them by sending corresponding events to Clearcut. It includes methods for initializing the receiver, running the server loop, processing messages, and joining the receiver thread.

classes.name: MetricsHostReceiver
classes.description: A class that manages a message queue to receive and process metrics-related messages, running in a separate thread.

methods.name: MetricsHostReceiver::MetricsHostReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the metrics enabled flag.

methods.name: MetricsHostReceiver::ServerLoop
methods.description: Main loop that receives messages from the queue and processes them.

methods.name: MetricsHostReceiver::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message queue and starts the server loop in a new thread if metrics are enabled.

methods.name: MetricsHostReceiver::ProcessMessage
methods.description: Processes a received message by sending corresponding events to Clearcut.
